title: Black Rose
body:
"Black roses are mysterious and rare, symbolizing death or farewell."

Description

The Black Rose are flowers, that can be found in the Magma Cave.

It can be sold to Jer Junkman for $300, or in the jar version for $1200

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by 4% per flower.

Trivia

  • The Black Rose spawns on an invisible material in the Magma Cave.
